what: InferenceResult::has_errors misses the body-tainting InferenceDiagnostics (taints_body, e.g. DuplicateField E0025): infer.rs sets it only from type mismatches and the resolver, so hir-ty-matchck still checks the body and reports E0005 on `let Foo { a: x, a: y, b: 0 } = x;` (tests::bodies::members::a_field_bound_twice, tests/ui/error-codes/E0025.rs). rustc taints typeck results on any error emitted during typeck, so check_match skips the body. Set has_errors |= diagnostics.any(taints_body) when freezing.

history.note: applied (infer.rs: has_errors |= any taints_body); round 19: a_field_bound_twice ok
